#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Project environment setup and initialization script.

This script ensures all dependencies and project modules
are properly configured before running any analysis tasks.
"""
import os
import sys
import subprocess

print("=== Running Environment Setup ===")

# Fix pandas dtype_backend compatibility issue
print("[1/3] Upgrading pandas to support dtype_backend...")
result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--upgrade", "pandas"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("      Pandas upgraded successfully.")

# Create project API module structure
print("[2/3] Creating project API module...")
os.makedirs("/app/src/api", exist_ok=True)

# Add __init__.py to make it a proper package
with open("/app/src/api/__init__.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("# API module initialization\n")

# Create helper.py with request fetching utility
helper_code = '''import requests

def fetch_url(url):
    """Fetch content from URL"""
    response = requests.get(url)
    return response.text
'''
with open("/app/src/api/helper.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(helper_code.strip() + "\n")
print("      Created /app/src/api/helper.py")

# Test the helper module import
print("[3/3] Testing helper module...")
sys.path.insert(0, "/app")
from src.api.helper import fetch_url
print("      fetch_url function imported successfully.")
print("      Helper module works correctly.")

print("\n=== Setup complete ===")
